value.evidence: 3/6 ordinary cases usable; 2 Loops preflights require more evidence; sequence1/3 before deterministic overlap fix.
value.consequence: Assisted prepared-brand email workflow useful; homepage-first autonomous promise not established.

effort.evidence: One real UI creation/run without optional settings; others API.
effort.consequence: Novice autonomy and active human time not measured.

reliability.evidence: Subscription interruption retained one of three emails; initial Next dev 404 required restart.
reliability.consequence: Cannot establish complete sequence delivery from this attempt.

economics.evidence: At least191 completed calls; exact full total/cost unknown because old map counters missing and compilation/revision dollar estimates incomplete. Subscription route verified.
economics.consequence: No complete margin or human time-saving claim.

usability.evidence: Two actual revision jobs, new checks, accept/decline/adjust-further, original/history, chosen copy/export verified.
usability.consequence: Observed revision UI usable; shortening request achieved only slightly on Papier.

reuse.evidence: Papier and systeme campaigns reused unchanged compiled knowledge; no new compile calls.
reuse.consequence: Second campaign can reuse existing preparation.

direct_model_advantage.evidence: Two direct controls usable, sometimes more concise and benefit-led.
direct_model_advantage.consequence: No blanket writing advantage established; workflow/evidence/version/export utility observed.
